verses.text: Palta haxo winhaj Jonás chi', te chuk ix yab' winh yujto ix sk'ex spensar Jehová, ix te kot yowal winh.

Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ina wal Mamin Jehová, haton wal jun tik ix in na' ayik ayin to ek' t'a in chonhab'. Yuj chi' ix in nib'ej ix in el lemnaj t'a ichanh, ix in b'atkan t'a Tarsis walani. Yujto wojtak to Dios ach, te ay wal ok'elk'olal, manh k'unok skot owal. Ayik tzalani to ol ak'och junok yahelal, junanto rato chi' sna'an pax sb'a a k'o'ol, yujto te niwan a k'o'ol.
Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayach Mamin Jehová to tzik'el in k 'inal, más am wach' to tzin chami, t'a yichanh pax to pitzan in, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tom wach' skot owal icha tik tza na'a? xchi t'a winh.
Ix el winh t'a sti'el chonhab' chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Hata' ix sb'ok'e xiltak te' winh t'a yib'anh, ix em k'ojan winh t'a yenhul chi', ix smaklan yil winh tas ol aj jun chonhab' chi'.
Haxo Jehová ix ak'an k'ib' jun ib' te' ch'upak'te'. Ha jun te' chi' ix k'ib'k'e yenhulok winh. Yuj chi' wach' yajek' winh ta'. Ix te tzalaj winh yuj te'.
Haxo yik ix k'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u, wan stakji'el te', yujto a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun nok' k'osnok' ix k'uxan sch'anhal yip te'.

Haxo yik ix k'e k'u, ix yak'ankot jun ik' Jehová te ow sk'ak'al t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, te ow ix em yok k'u t'a sjolom winhaj Jonás chi'. Ix och ijan yel yip winh yuj k'ak' chi'. Yuj chi' ix snib'ej cham sb'a winh. Ix yalan winh: --Más am wach' tzin chami, t'a yichanh pax to pitzan in, xchi winh.

Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tom wach' tza k'ulej skot owal yujnhej to ix takji'el te te' ix k'ib'k'e enhulok chi'? xchi Jehová. --Ay walan wiko', wach'chom tzin cham yuj wowal tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tok a ach ix awej jun te te' tik? ¿Tok a ach pax ix ak' k'ib' te'? Junnhej ak'wal ix k'ib' te', haxo t'a junxo ak'wal ix takjixi'el te'. Palta a ach tik tzach kus yuj te'.
Ha in xo pax tik, ¿tom manh ol kus in k'ol yuj jun niwan chonhab' Nínive tik, ek'to 120 mil heb' unin mantalaj spensar kajan t'ay? Hanhejtona', manh jantakok pax nok' nok' ay t'ay, xchi t'a winh.
